test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

Nobody was interested in the fish __who Gopal had catch__ from the river.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****which Gopal had caught'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of pronoun 'who' and incorrect form of verb with 'had'.
 
• The pronoun **'who' **is used in reference to **people** whereas **'which**' is used in reference to **things.**
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• The musician **who **wrote this song is Canadian.
 
• Jason bought the top hybrid car **which **will help him save on gas.
 
 
 
• The verb** 'had' **is usually followed by the third form of the verb.
 
• Thus, **'which' **will be used in place of **'who',** and** 'caught'** will be used in place of **'catch'.**

 

Correct sentence: __*Nobody was interested in the fish __**which Gopal had caught**__ from the river.*
